class.name: SlsaProvenance
class.description: Generates and signs SLSA v1.0 provenance for the build's artifacts, server-side, and publishes the provenance.sigstore.json artifact.

param.name: slsa.signer
param.description: Where the signing key lives. For AWS KMS, the credentials method is a nested choice.

param.name: slsa.server.privateKeyPath
param.description: Absolute path to a PEM private key on the server (EC, RSA, or Ed25519; PKCS#8 for any, plus PKCS#1/SEC1 for RSA/EC).

param.name: slsa.aws.region
param.description: KMS key region (e.g. us-east-1). Optional: when omitted, the AWS SDK resolves the region from the environment (AWS_REGION, profile, or instance metadata).

param.name: slsa.kms.keyId
param.description: Asymmetric SIGN_VERIFY KMS key: id, alias, or ARN.

param.name: slsa.kms.signingAlgorithm
param.description: Must match the key spec (e.g. ECDSA_SHA_256).

param.name: slsa.aws.credentials
param.description: How the server authenticates to AWS.

param.name: secure:slsa.aws.secretAccessKey
param.description: AWS secret access key. Stored encrypted.

param.name: slsa.aws.assumeRole.enabled
param.description: For an AWS KMS signer, wrap the selected base credentials in an assumed IAM role. Set roleArn when enabled.

param.name: slsa.aws.assumeRole.arn
param.description: IAM role assumed before signing. Scope it to kms:Sign. Required when assumeRole is enabled.

param.name: slsa.aws.assumeRole.externalId
param.description: External id for the role's trust policy, if required.

param.name: slsa.failBuildOnError
param.description: Fail the build when provenance cannot be produced. Off by default (logs a warning).

example.description: Sign with an AWS KMS key using the server's default credentials provider chain.
Sign with an AWS KMS key, deriving credentials from the default chain and then assuming a kms:Sign-scoped IAM role, and fail the build on error.
Sign with an AWS KMS key using static access keys as the base identity, then assuming an IAM role.
Sign with a PEM private key stored on the TeamCity server.
